_readme: HOMEPAGE COVER IMAGE - the first recorded frame is the static hero; the approved illustration is disclosed.
Edit mode: replace the cover image, then publish with its own alt text and credit.
An incomplete replacement keeps the credited original visible.
Published replacements are baked into the next deploy.
Only slides[0] is rendered. Other recorded frames are retained as alternative imagery.
An empty array uses the credited Cape Schanck default.
Preserve image rights records and accurate captions when changing a source.
The cover.image CMS slot is preserved. There is no automatic motion or slideshow.

slides.alt: Conceptual coastal illustration of a teal bay, jetty and people beneath a yellow parasol
slides.caption: Conceptual coastal illustration, not a specific location.
